linear.name: Linear Motion
linear.description: Valves where the closure member moves in a straight line to start, stop, or throttle flow.

gate.name: Gate Valves
gate.description: Sliding-disc valves primarily designed for on-off isolation with minimal flow restriction.

valves.name: Wedge Gate Valve
valves.description: A gate valve utilizing a wedge-shaped disc that matches the taper of the seats to ensure reliable shutoff under high pressure.
valves.workingPrinciple: The stem rotates through a threaded assembly, translating handwheel rotation into a linear downward or upward gate displacement. The wedge slides perpendicular to the flow, sealing against angled seat rings to block the fluid pathway.
advantages: Extremely low pressure drop (straight-through flow pathway when fully open)
Tight sealing characteristics under high pressures
limitations: Not suitable for throttling (localized high-velocity flow causes rapid erosion/chatter)
Slow opening and closing times compared to quarter-turn valves
Susceptible to thermal binding in high-temperature applications
typicalApplications: Main isolation pipelines for oil and gas

internalComponents.name: Handwheel
internalComponents.functionality: Provides manual torque to actuate the stem assembly.

internalComponents.name: Stem
internalComponents.functionality: Translates rotational mechanical motion into linear motion to lift or lower the wedge.

internalComponents.name: Wedge / Disc
internalComponents.functionality: The closure member that blocks or permits fluid flow.

internalComponents.name: Seat Rings
internalComponents.functionality: Provides a sealing surface for the wedge to press against.

internalComponents.name: Stuffing Box Gland
internalComponents.functionality: Compresses packing rings around the stem to prevent external leakage.

standards: API 600 (Steel Gate Valves - Flanged and Butt-welding Ends)
ASME B16.34 (Valves Flanged, Threaded and Welding End)

globe.name: Globe Valves
globe.description: Valves featuring a spherical body cavity designed for throttling and flow regulation.

valves.name: Standard Globe Valve
valves.description: A linear motion valve featuring a tortuous Z-shaped path optimized for regulating and throttling flow rates.
valves.workingPrinciple: A plug or disc moves linearly relative to a seat ring located at the center of the flow passage. Flow is routed upward through the seat, allowing fine regulation as the plug adjusts the flow gap size.
advantages: Excellent throttling and flow control capabilities
Shorter stem travel compared to gate valves
Easy seat repair and refurbishment capability
limitations: High pressure drop (tortuous flow path forces fluid direction changes)
Higher operating torque required to close against line pressure
Typically unidirectional flow (must install relative to flow arrow)
typicalApplications: Boiler feed lines and bypass lines
Cooling water systems requiring flow regulation

internalComponents.name: Plug / Disc
internalComponents.functionality: The throttling element that seats into the orifice to restrict flow.

internalComponents.name: Seat Ring
internalComponents.functionality: The stationary circular orifice that the plug seats into.

internalComponents.name: Stem
internalComponents.functionality: Connects the plug to the actuator, transmitting linear force.

internalComponents.name: Bonnet
internalComponents.functionality: Retains the stem seals and structural integrity of the upper body.

standards: BS 1873 (Steel Globe and Globe Stop and Check Valves)
ASME B16.34 (Valves Flanged, Threaded and Welding End)
API 623 (Steel Globe Valves - Flanged and Butt-welding Ends)

rotary.name: Rotary Motion
rotary.description: Valves utilizing a quarter-turn rotation of the closure element to control flow paths.

ball.name: Ball Valves
ball.description: Quarter-turn valves using a spherical closure member with a drilled fluid port.

valves.name: Floating Ball Valve
valves.description: A quarter-turn valve where the ball is held between two soft seats, enabling upstream pressure to push the ball against the downstream seat for a tight seal.
valves.workingPrinciple: Rotating the stem 90 degrees aligns the ball's internal bore with the pipe axis. Turning it back perpendicular shifts the bore away, sealing the cavity. Line pressure moves the ball slightly downstream to compress the seat seal.
advantages: Low pressure drop in full-port models
limitations: High operating torque under high differential pressures
Poor throttling capabilities due to localized seat erosion
Prone to seat distortion if left partially open
typicalApplications: Process lines in chemical and petrochemical plants
Utility water and gas isolate manifolds

internalComponents.name: Floating Ball
internalComponents.functionality: Rotatable sphere containing a flow port to block or permit passage.

internalComponents.name: Seat Rings (Soft)
internalComponents.functionality: Provide a low-friction, tight-sealing cradle for the floating ball.

internalComponents.name: Stem
internalComponents.functionality: Engages the slot on top of the ball to transmit rotational torque.

standards: ISO 17292 (Metal Ball Valves for Petroleum and Petrochemical)
API 607 (Fire Test for Soft-Seated Quarter-Turn Valves)

butterfly.name: Butterfly Valves
butterfly.description: Compact, lightweight quarter-turn valves using a disc rotating about an internal axis.

valves.name: Triple Offset Butterfly Valve (TOV)
valves.description: A high-performance butterfly valve with three geometric offsets that eliminate friction between the seal ring and the body seat during travel.
valves.workingPrinciple: The shaft is offset from the center of the valve body and disc, and the seat sealing cone is inclined. This geometry causes the disc to engage the seat only at the final point of shutoff, minimizing friction and wear.
advantages: Bi-directional sealing capability at high temperatures and pressures
Low torque requirements relative to pressure drop limits
limitations: More expensive than concentric resilient butterfly valves
Inherent cavity obstruction (disc is always in the flow stream)
Sensitive to piping misalignment and line stress
typicalApplications: Cryogenic fluids and liquefied natural gas (LNG) systems

internalComponents.name: Offset Disc
internalComponents.functionality: The rotating barrier with a conical profile matching the body seat.

internalComponents.name: Metal Seat Ring
internalComponents.functionality: Precision seat integrated into the valve body to withstand metal disc contact.

internalComponents.name: Shaft / Stem
internalComponents.functionality: Dual or single offset shafts transmitting rotary actuation torque.

standards: API 609 (Butterfly Valves: Double Flanged, Lug and Wafer-Type)
ASME B16.34 (Valves Flanged, Threaded and Welding End)
ISO 10631 (Metallic Butterfly Valves for General Purposes)

self-actuated.name: Self-Actuated
self-actuated.description: Valves operating automatically using system energy (flow direction, line pressure, or spring forces).

check.name: Check Valves
check.description: Non-return valves preventing reverse flow in systems.

valves.name: Swing Check Valve
valves.description: A non-return valve using a pivoted disc that swings open with forward flow and closes via gravity and reverse pressure.
valves.workingPrinciple: Fluid velocity in the forward direction forces the disc to swing upward off the seat. When flow velocity drops to zero or reverses, gravity and downstream pressure push the disc back onto the seat to prevent backflow.
advantages: Completely automatic operation requiring no external control system
Low fluid resistance (straight-through flow pattern when fully open)
Can be used in systems with fluctuating flow velocities
limitations: Prone to water hammer if flow reverses rapidly (slamming check)
Not suitable for vertical-down flow piping systems
Accelerated hinge pin and disc wear in highly turbulent lines
typicalApplications: Pump discharge lines to prevent back-flow spinning

internalComponents.name: Swing Disc / Clapper
internalComponents.functionality: The pivoting closure member that moves under fluid pressure.

internalComponents.name: Hinge Pin
internalComponents.functionality: The axis about which the disc pivots or swings.

internalComponents.name: Seat Ring
internalComponents.functionality: The stationary seal ring that matches the face of the swing disc.

standards: BS 1868 (Steel Check Valves for Petroleum, Petrochemical)
